messages:
deploy-bot: Starting canary rollout v2026.03 -> us-east-1 (group: alpha, 10%)
deploy-bot: health-checks enabled, auto-abort on >=5% 5xx over 2m
sarah_eng: seeing elevated 5xx on the canary pods, ~14:31 UTC - mounting around 2m ago :eyes:
sarah_eng: sample log: `2026-03-17T14:30:45Z ERROR upstream request failed status=503 kvcache timeout`
raj_oncall: paging @raj_oncall — taking this now, grabbing pod logs and metrics
ops-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered for SRE escalation -> @raj_oncall
raj_oncall: confirmed 5xx spike across 3 of 6 canary pods, latency up ~220ms, errors ~6.3% (exceeding abort threshold)
jamie_sre: investigating kvcache timeouts in the runtime layer, looks correlated with new sharding logic in this rollout
sarah_eng: suggestion: flip safety-suppress to false? feature flag `alpha_new_sharding` is still ON for canary
raj_oncall: we should abort before it hits more traffic. Requesting manual kill-switch: someone toggle `canary_alpha_enabled` -> false
maria_pm: cc: @customer-success — any immediate customer impact? we need statement if CS gets pinged
jamie_sre: small impact: downstream request errors show ~0.5% of active customers affected (likely heavy prefix workloads). Not widespread but unacceptable to escalate further
raj_oncall: toggled `canary_alpha_enabled=false` via deploy-console -> response: `success`
deploy-bot: Canary aborted by operator (reason: healthcheck 5xx threshold). Initiating rollback to v2026.02.
customer-success-bot: Ticket CS-12345 created: "Canary rollout caused increased 5xx for subset of customers"; assigned to CS triage
raj_oncall: rolling back, running `kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference-runtime --to-revision=2026.02`
ops-bot: Rollback completed, pods stabilized. Health checks returning to normal.
sarah_eng: will open a follow-up PR to revert sharding change and add stricter KV timeout guards. TAGGING this as postmortem candidate.
maria_pm: noted — prepping customer comms and internal incident notification.
raj_oncall: handing off monitoring to night oncall @oliver_oncall for 2h observation window :thumbsup:
oliver_oncall: ack, will monitor logs/metrics and escalate if error rate rises above 1%
jamie_sre: saving traces and span logs to S3: `s3://redwood-artifacts/canary-1779998888/` for postmortem
